{{Money|1,920}} on death (Hard) |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = {{Attr|Health Regen}} (Variable) |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Extra Extravaganza}}''' - Upon death, the '''Extra D''' spawns three [[Extra C]]s. }} ==Description== '''Extra D''' was a summoner enemy that appeared in [[The Narratorium]] as a part of [[The Final Act Event]]. It was an enemy that has a decent amount of health and a slightly fast speed. Upon death, it will spawn three [[Extra C]]s, which are invulnerable for a short period of time. Those have less health but are faster and can spawn two [[Extra B]]s upon death, which in turn can spawn one [[Extra A]] upon death. ==Logbook Description== "''The Extras are positioned throughout theater productions, serving as background characters in scenes and sometimes disguising themselves as objects to help move set pieces during transitions. They are typically assigned boring tasks that the Builder doesn't want to do, though their suffering is hidden beneath tear-painted masks.''" ==Appearance== The '''Extra D''' is a big and dark creature which wears a purple suit with crosses on it and a white vest. On its head, it wears a white mask with golden accents and a purple hat. ==Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[The Narratorium]] is listed instead. *The '''Extra D''' summons in three [[Extra C]]s, which can only happen upon death. **The [[Hacker]] can negate its ability, preventing it from summoning [[Extra C]]s. *High DPS towers, like the [[Turret]], [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Ranger]], [[Warlock]] and [[Pursuit]] are recommended against this. **Towers like the [[Pursuit]], [[Warlock]] or [[Ranger]] are especially useful due them being able to hit multiple extras at once. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Abilities |- |[[File:BreakerDeath.ogg]] |When the '''Extra D''' dies |} }}}} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} ExtraDWalk.gif|Walking animation (20 December 2025 – Present) ExtraDStun.gif|Stun animation (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseExtraD.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} TheFinalActPI4.png|'''Extra D''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Cutscenes}} "The Final Act" Cutscenes - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Extra D''' in [[The Narratorium]] cutscenes. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} ExtraDIconIG.png|'''Extra D''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Extra D''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''20 December 2025''' - [[v1.83.0]]a **'''Extra D''' added. *'''11 March 2026''' - [[v1.86.0]] **'''Extra D''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{TheNarratorium|[[Security]]|Wave 21|Extra D|Wave 22|[[Spindling]]|Wave 23}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
